source.name: Yotsuba Society Archives, part 2 (per-board tarballs)
source.capture:
IA identifier is `yotsuba-society-archives_part-2`, with an UNDERSCORE. The local dir is deliberately named ...-part-2-small instead, because Yotsuba Society published two items whose identifiers differ only by that one character -- `yotsuba-society-archives-part-2` (hyphen) is a different, much larger item with a different layout, and two local directories differing only by hyphen-vs-underscore is a trap. This is the only source where dir does not mirror the IA identifier; `link` still carries the real one.

Small by design, and 5 boards is the whole item, not a partial download: IA lists exactly 3.tar.gz, aco.tar.gz, adv.tar.gz, an.tar.gz, asp.tar.gz plus bookkeeping (verified against _files.xml). That is 45 threads total -- 3:4, aco:1, adv:38, an:1, asp:1 -- so an ingest finishing in under two seconds with 0 new posts is the correct result, not a staging failure. It contributed 2263 posts when first ingested; everything else in it had already been supplied by another archive.

4chan JSON API thread dumps, one tar.gz per board, laid out as <board>/<threadno>/<threadno>.json alongside the rendered HTML and assets.

prepare.name: untar the per-board archives
prepare.run: mkdir -p extracted && for f in source/*.tar.gz; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue; tar xzf "$f" -C extracted; done

prepare.name: stage the thread tree for ingest
prepare.run: rm -rf out && (cp -al extracted out 2>/dev/null || cp -a extracted out)
